rationale: The 60-step checkpoint-3 trajectory reached exactly 60 steps without a MiniSWE completion action and remained in active debugging. This is the single maximum-budget calibration authorized by amendment 01.

final_decision_rule.headroom_confirmed: Checkpoint-3 no-transfer Core is at least 2/8. Activate the planned transfer treatments with the same 120-step cap.
final_decision_rule.borderline: Checkpoint-3 no-transfer Core is 1/8. Do not run the full main contrast; at most run one manager treatment as a directional engineering probe.
final_decision_rule.headroom_not_confirmed: Checkpoint-3 no-transfer Core is 0/8 after an explicit completion action. Abandon code_search for the main transfer contrast.
final_decision_rule.operationally_infeasible: The trajectory reaches 120 steps without a completion action or fails from context/runtime limits. Abandon this model-task pair for the main contrast as operationally infeasible, without claiming model incapability.
